sourceRules.author: Stephen Pierce
sourceRules.section: Fix It:Ulna Deviation,last two paragraphs beginning When I first teach scales and I begin with contrary motion
sourceRules.rule: After separate five-finger positions,the author uses contrary motion to align matching fingers and mirrored movements.Our three-key outer-finger staccato contour is a project adaptation of the coordination principle,not his printed or video exercise.No video,coins,rigid-joint drills,two-hour practice prescription or medical claim adopted.
